headline: Drone shows debut at 88; tech-explainers falls 18 points to 46
paragraphs: First scores: drone-light-shows 88, hyper-casual-mobile-gameplay 85, guided-prayers 47 (25% breakout rate). Biggest drops since yesterday: tech-explainers 64 to 46, cyber-stories 76 to 64, business-case-studies 80 to 71. no-code-automation rose 79 to 81.

New breakouts in drone-light-shows: Lumasky Drone Show's Messi tribute, 2,180.8x its channel's typical views (1,960,541 views, 25,700 subscribers), and OrionTallica78's Godzilla show at Dodger Stadium, 838.9x (148,060 views, 526 subscribers). Lofi multiples up to 61,249x are provisional.

Added three niches to track: cybersecurity-tips, smart-home-reviews and career-resume-tips, from OutlierKit's September 2026 faceless-niche table, not this week's data. Thumbnails did not load, so 9 channel entries (7 verdicts, 2 non-English flags), no thumbnail tags and titles-only niche notes.
